'''Tooms''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Hassk]] [[pirate]] who served as a member of [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. He assisted them during an [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] on the ''[[Colossus]]''. During the battle, a disturbance occurred over the comm channel and Tooms was put off by the sound. After another [[Unidentified Warbird pirate|pirate]] was shot down, Gorr ordered the rest of them to retreat. Tooms had [[Color|gray]] [[hair]], orange [[eye]]s, and gray skin.<ref name="The Triple Dark" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tooms first appeared in "[[The Triple Dark]]," the second episode of [[Star Wars Resistance]] [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|Season One]]. He was voiced by [[Jonathan Lipow]] who also voiced both [[Hallion Nark]] and [[Nod]] in the episode.
